meta.title: FindYourDent: understand your dental problem
meta.description: Describe your dental problem and get educational information: how urgent it is, what it may be, a cost estimate and BPJS coverage.

home.headline: Toothache? Understand it before you see a dentist.
home.intro: Describe your problem in your own words. We explain how urgent it is, what it may be, what it might cost, and whether BPJS covers it.
home.consent: Educational information, not a diagnosis. Your complaint text is not stored and is processed by Google AI outside Indonesia.
home.complaintPlaceholder: Example: my lower left molar has been throbbing for three days and hurts more at night
home.complaintHint: Write in Indonesian, a regional language, or English.
